entry.hypothesis: Names with at least one officer/director open-market purchase filing usable in the trailing 63 sessions beat the equal-weight PIT basket when overlaid on it (PREREG C0, the purchase-count baseline every refinement must beat).
entry.rationale: Insiders buy with their own money only when they expect a rise (Seyhun 1986, Lakonishok & Lee 2001); the fact of buying alone, and the confounder for every refined rule.

stopped_names.rule: D07: a holding is sold at the close of its last stored print; no open is fabricated
